title: First, 'meatball sub,' and now 'deli meat.' Even Justin Herbert's passes are getting the Subway treatment

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: First, 'meatball sub,' and now 'deli meat.' Even Justin Herbert's passes are getting the Subway treatment
sources.description: Justin Herbert said he was unaware of comments by Rams safety Quentin Lake, who said on a podcast that the Chargers quarterback was "throwing deli meat" during the teams' game on Sunday.
